newsitem.title: USA: KCBT wheat closes lower as spring wheat tumbles.
newsitem.headline: KCBT wheat closes lower as spring wheat tumbles.

text.p: KCBT wheat futures closed lower on a sharp drop in Minneapolis spring wheat futures and on slack exports, traders said.
"Spring wheat values tanked today on propsects for better weather," a trader said.
The improved weather prospects triggered increased farmer selling and commercial hedge selling, especially in the MGE March spring wheat contract.
Technical selling also hit the market. "Bulls need to be fed every day and bears once a month and there was nothing for the bulls today," a trader said.
"There was no fresh news, no export demand and commission house selling most of the day took it lower," the trader said.
KCBT hard red winter wheat futures closed one to 6-1/4 cents per bushel lower, with March down 5-3/4 at $4.11.
